abstract: Maintains bentonite slurry transport quota and licensed processing capacity records
system_message:
You are the Slurry and spoil disposal manager (SLURRY), responsible for maintaining bentonite slurry transport quotas, licensed processing capacity records, and dewatering plant spoil cake density assays across tunneling consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Spoil cake density inspection（MOIST）
information_points.content:
SLURRY-MOIST-AH2：Gravimetric assays of squeezed filter cake before haulage confirm that Apex Hydro-Excavation Partners registers a filter press moisture fraction of 18% on its daily discharge batches.
SLURRY-MOIST-7IP：According to dewatering plant gravimetric assays of daily dewatered silt-cake discharge batches, Aegis Metro Underground JV shows a filter press moisture fraction of 30%.
SLURRY-MOIST-6B1：Daily dewatered silt-cake discharge gravimetric assays at the dewatering plant indicate that Borealis GeoInfrastructure Group achieves a filter press moisture fraction of 24%.

information_points.title: Maintains bentonite slurry transport quota and licensed processing capacity records（DISP）
information_points.content:
SLURRY-DISP-KCY：Borealis GeoInfrastructure Group holds an authorized municipal environmental discharge permit permitting a total weekly licensed slurry disposal volume of 2,100 m3/week across regional hazardous slurry recycling and separation facilities.
SLURRY-DISP-WSW：Under its municipal environmental discharge permit for authorized regional hazardous slurry recycling and separation plants, Aegis Metro Underground JV has a licensed slurry disposal volume of 1,750 m3/week.
SLURRY-DISP-C18：Apex Hydro-Excavation Partners maintains a licensed slurry disposal volume of 2,100 m3/week under its municipal environmental discharge permit for regional hazardous slurry processing plants.
